failure: Clang notification revocation poll returned ACCESS_DENIED instead of test-only FILE_CLOSED expectation. GCC/MSVC jobs passed.
cause: A notify poll authorized before the policy epoch update can reach the file service after revocation and fail grant validation; later polls reach the already-drained handle table and fail with FILE_CLOSED. Both deny events.
change: Accept either in-flight denial, then require the old handle query to return FILE_CLOSED and a fresh exclusive read-only open to succeed. Production authorization behavior is unchanged.
